reference: Saito, Y., Aihara, S., Matsutani, M., & Narita, Y. (2021). Open Bandit Dataset and Pipeline: Towards realistic and reproducible off-policy evaluation. arXiv:2008.07146v5 (26 Oct 2021). NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.
transcription_note: Values transcribed from arXiv:2008.07146v5 in two independent passes that agreed on every number. CTR in percent; RMSE values are x 10^3; values in brackets in the paper (RMSE divided by the best estimator) are recomputed here, not stored.

table1.caption_summary: Statistics of OBD. The +/- value is a 95% confidence interval from the normal approximation of Bernoulli sampling (percentage points). Relative CTR is against Random in the ALL campaign.

protocol_from_code.source: github.com/st-tech/zr-obp, benchmark/ope (commit 8cbd5fa), locked to obp 0.5.0, pyieoe 0.1.1, scikit-learn 0.24.2, numpy 1.21.2, pandas 1.3.3, Python 3.9
protocol_from_code.tuning: estimated MSE = sample variance / n + (high-probability bias upper bound)^2, delta = 0.05 (obp 0.5.0 defaults); tuned once and reused
protocol_from_code.ground_truth: mean click of the full log of the evaluation policy
protocol_from_code.bootstrap: seed s in 0..199: np.random.seed(s); idx = np.random.choice(arange(n), size=n, replace=True) over the first n rows in time order
